title: Matsurika Kanriden Releases New Trailer Featuring Opening Theme Song by Kana Boon
content:
The previously announced Matsurika Kanriden anime released a new trailer featuring the opening thems song “Hana Hanashi” by Kana Boon. The anime is slated to broadcast in January 2027 with Maho Film in charge of the animation.

Rie Takahashi stars as Matsurika Ko and Nobunaga Shimazaki as Emperor Hakuyo. Three new voice cast members were also revealed:

• Takeo Otsuka as Tenga Rei

• Kotaro Nishiyama as Shisei Ho

• Sho Komura as Shunsetsu Sho

Takeshi Mori is the chief director while Yuichi Nakazawa is the director. Toko Machida is handling the series composition, Manami Inose is on character designs, and Takuro Iga is composing the music. The story follows the titular character, Matsurika, a lady-in-waiting at the imperial palace known for her excellent memory. One day, she meets the emperor, who falls in love with her, but tells her to approach him only after passing an exam.

The light novel series is written by Rinne Ishida and has been published under Kadokawa’s B’s-LOG Bunko label since July 2017. There is also a manga adaptation by Waka Takase, which has been serialized in Akita Shoten’s shojo manga magazine Princess since August 2018.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, 2027 Premiere
content:
An official website opened for the television anime adaptation of Nikita Kitagawa 's Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe wo Surinuketara, Shokai Clear Houshuu wo Mugen Kaishuu Dekimashita! light novel on Friday and revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

• Voice actors Riko Aono ( Fumetsu no Anata e Season 3 ) and Momoka Terasawa ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! ) are starring in the anime as Henri and Elerate, respectively.

Staff Director: Haruki Kasugamori ( Astro Note ) Series Composition: Hiroshi Hosokawa Character Design: Hiroshi Miyamoto ( Precure Dream Stars! Movie ), Sumakidori ( Miru: Watashi no Mirai ) Studio: Durandal , Tengu Kobo Production: Kabenuke Bug Production Committee

Kitagawa began writing the adventure fantasy web novel on Shousetsuka ni Narou in February 2021. Kodansha later launched the light novel with illustrations by Meto Sasame under the Kodansha Ranobe Books imprint in June 2022, with the second and final volume released in May 2024.

A manga adaptation by Yui Hata began serialization on Magazine Pocket in June 2022. The 12th volume went on sale on July 9.

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Reveals Cour 2 Visual, Heroines Cover Mrs. GREEN APPLE's "Ao to Natsu"
content:
Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle anime revealed a new key visual for its second cour, ahead of the anime’s October 2026 return. The first cour concluded in March. Studio feel. is in charge of the animation. The main voice cast for the anime includes:

• Shogo Sakata as Saku Chitose

• Manaka Iwami as Yuko Hiiragi

• Hina Youmiya as Yua Uchida

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Yuzuki Nanase

• Rumi Okubo as Haru Aomi

• Chika Anzai as Asuka Nishino

You can see the main characters in the new visual below.

A new music project featuring the five heroines covering songs associated with youth was also announced. The first release is a cover of Mrs. GREEN APPLE’s “Ao to Natsu,” with a music video now available.

The following staff is credited for the Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle anime:

• Original Work: Hiromu

• Original Character Design: raemz

• Director: Yuji Tokuno

• Series Structure: Naruhisa Arakawa

• Script: Hiromu, Naruhisa Arakawa

• Character Design: Sumie Kinoshita

• Animation Production: feel.

The anime is adapting a light novel series written by Hiromu and illustrated by raemz. Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle has been serialized by Shogakukan’s Gagaga Bunko imprint since June 2019. A manga adaptation by Bobcat began in Square Enix’s Manga Up! in April 2020.

Yen Press licensed the light novel l in English, describing the story: Being popular isn’t easy. It’s hard to beat Saku Chitose. The most popular kid in his high school? Check. An ironclad reputation that can weather even vicious online attacks? Check. A group of friends as attractive on the outside as they are inside? Check. But when a teacher asks for his help bringing back a student who has been shut away in his room for months, Saku’s perfect world will never be the same. What is this, some kind of normie harem story…?
author: Anime Corner

title: A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage Anime Reveals First Visual and Trailer, Cast, January 2027 Release
content:
A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage anime revealed the first teaser visual and trailer, along with the main cast and January 2027 release date. Takaaki Ishiyama is directing the anime at EMT Squared, with Shigeru Murakoshi handling the series composition. Miyuki Nakamura is the character designer, Hiroto Morishita serves as sound director, and Kana Hashiguchi is composing the music.

The main voice cast consists of the following members:

• Tomoaki Maeno as Eiji Kirisame

• Inori Minase as Tsugumi Kuchinashi

You can watch the teaser trailer below.

Also check out the teaser visual:

A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage is based on the manga written by Shinichi Sawaragi and illustrated by Tank Gasuyama, currently serialized in Hakusensha’s Young Animal . The manga has surpassed 400,000 copies in circulation through six volumes as of April 2026. Yen Press licensed it in English, describing the story:

Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence—and besides, it seems like Tsugumi might have a knack for deduction! So he’ll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But, uh, does that last page really say…“Marry me?”?!

title: 'Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shinichi Sawaragi 's Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon ( A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime will premiere in January 2027.

Voice actors Tomoaki Maeno ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ) and Inori Minase ( Dead Mount Death Play ) are starring the anime as Eiji Kirisame and Tsugumi Kuchinashi, respectively.

Staff Director: Takaaki Ishiyama ( Rinkai! ) Series Composition: Shigeru Murakoshi ( Apocalypse Hotel ) Character Design: Miyuki Nakamura ( Kanchigai no Atelier Meister ) Sound Director: Hiroto Morishita ( Nihon e Youkoso Elf-san. ) Music: Kana Hashiguchi ( Kamiina Botan, Yoeru Sugata wa Yuri no Hana ) Studio: EMT Squared

Sawaragi began serializing the mystery romance series in Young Animal in December 2022, illustrated by Tank Gasuyama . Hakusensha published the seventh volume on April 28.

Yen press licensed the manga in English in August 2025. The first volume went on sale on March 24, and the second volume is scheduled for release on September 22.

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 First Trailer Revealed
content:
A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special Season 2 revealed a new trailer ahead of its October 2026 release date. Studio Arvo Animation is back to animate, with Taishi Kawaguchi returning as director. The anime previously revealed that FLOW will again be in charge of the opening theme . The band was previously in charge of Season 1’s opening song, “GET BACK,” and will return with a new song titled “Sorrow” for Season 2. You can watch the new trailer below.

The main cast includes:

• Takuma Terashima as Desir Herrman

• Asami Seto as Azrest Kingscrown

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Pram Schnaize

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Romaintica Elle

You can also see the new visual:

A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special is based on a web novel by So-nan Yu and Uk-jakga, which was first published on KakaoPage from September 2016 to August 2019. It also received a webtoon adaptation with illustrations by Wookjakga, which KakaoPage started serializing in May 2018. It is published by Piccoma digitally and Kadokawa Shoten in print in Japan.

Yen Press has licensed the manga in English, and they describe the story: Shadow Realms have ravaged the earth and decimated almost everyone in their way. The survival of humanity hinges upon the success of just six mages, including analytic fighter Desir Herrman. The remaining heroes make one final stand to end the bloodshed…but to no avail. Desir closes his eyes on what should be the end of his life—only to open them and see the beginning of his school days?! Desir has returned thirteen years back to the past, where he’s been given another chance. A chance to see the loved ones he lost, a chance to meet his fellow warriors again, and a chance to save the world…!

A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special Season 2 is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.

title: Shota Oni Anime Titled Ore to Yu-nii! Reveals Teaser Trailer, January 2027 Release
content:
The anime adaptation of Miyuki Nakayama’s Shota Oni , titled Ore to Yuu-nii! , revealed a teaser trailer and January 2027 release. Noriko Hashimoto is directing the anime at Studio Hibari, with Yuniko Ayana handling the series composition. Yumi Kuroiwa serves as character designer and chief animation director.

Shinnosuke Tokudome as Tsubaki Sawashiro and Shuichiro Umeda as Yu Shimizu lead the voice cast. You can watch the teaser trailer below.

Ore to Yuu-nii! is based on Miyuki Nakayama’s Shota Oni , which is published by Square Enix under its GanGan BLiss label. The series follows Tsubaki and Yuu through their ordinary, affectionate daily lives together.

title: Matsurika Kanriden TV Anime Reveals Kana-Boon's Theme Song in Promo Video
content:
Kadokawa unveiled the first main promotional video, more cast, and opening theme artist on Friday for the television anime of Rinne Ishida and Izumi 's Matsurika Kanriden (The Tale of the Scholar-Official Matsurika) light novel series. KANA-BOON performs the opening theme song "Hana Hanashi" (Flower Talk).

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Tenga Rei

• Kōtarō Nishiyama as Shisei Hō

• Shō Komura as Shunsetsu Shō

The anime will debut in January 2027 and will air on Tokyo MX , MBS , TV Aichi , and BS11 in Japan.

The anime stars Rie Takahashi as Matsurika Kō and Nobunaga Shimazaki as Emperor Hakuyō.

Takeshi Mori ( Vandread , Gunsmith Cats , Otaku no Video ) is the supervising director for the anime, while Yūichi Nakazawa is directing the anime at Maho Film . Tōko Machida ( Lucky Star , The IDOLM@STER , My Master Has No Tail ) is in charge of series composition. Manami Inose ( Blue Miburo ) is designing the characters. Takurō Iga is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Chief Animation Directors: Manami Inose, Kaho Deguchi

• Art Director: Satoshi Shibata

• Color Design: Kumiko Akahori

• Director of Photography: Yukina Nomura

• Editing: Honami Yamagishi (REAL-T)

• Sound Director: Yasunori Ebina

The fantasy romance novels, inspired by Chinese history, center on the titular Matsurika, a court lady serving at the emperor's inner palace, who is known for her good memory. One day, she receives a request to serve as a practice partner for the marriage meeting for the son a certain noble house. But when she arrives to meet this noble scion, it turns out to be none other than Emperor Hakuyō himself. The emperor falls in love with her at first sight, but tells her to come to him once she passes the state's scholar-official civil service exam.

Ishida published the first light novel in the series in July 2017, with illustrations by Izumi . The 18th and most recent volume shipped in October 2025, and the 19th volume will ship on October 15.

Takase launched the manga adaptation of the novels in Akita Shoten 's Monthly Princess magazine in August 2018. Akita Shoten published the manga's 12th volume in October 2025. The manga's first part also ended in October 2025, and the second part started in May.

The series has over 2 million copies in circulation (including digital editions).
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Removes Chainsmoker Cat from Their YouTube Channel
content:
Yaniko’s troubles continue. Ani-One Asia announced that it will remove Chainsmoker Cat from its YouTube channel. The company mentioned that the removal was due to “local government regulations in local markets” and apologized for any inconvenience. Ani-One’s removal of Yani Neko comes days after the Anime Crazy streaming service pulled the anime from its Hong Kong site . Anime Crazy mentioned that Hong Kong’s Department of Health found Chainsmoker Cat to be in contravention of sections 13B and 14 of the Smoking (Public Health) Ordinance.

Ani-One Asia did not specify which regulations led to the anime’s removal. However, countries like the Philippines have several laws against the promotion of tobacco products , especially on domestic TV, radio, and internet communications. Thailand also prohibits the promotion of tobacco products but does allow the “unpaid depiction of tobacco use/products in TV, film, or other media.”

Chainsmoker Cat Details

The Chainsmoker Cat anime adapts the manga by NyanNyanFactory. Yani Neko follows Yaniko, a demi-human catgirl with a severe nicotine addiction. The show frequently depicts Yaniko going to extreme (comedic) lengths to feed her addiction. Several of her friends and neighbors also regularly smoke, drink, and consume illicit drugs.

Weekly Young Magazine (Kodansha) has serialized the manga since its February 2023 debut. Kodansha compiled its chapters into 13 tankobon volumes. Seven Seas Entertainment began releasing the English version in February 2025. Bibury Animation Studios animates the series. Taku Kimura directs Chainsmoker Cat . The anime’s voice cast includes:

• Yuko Natsuyoshi as Yaniko Sato

• Misato Matsuoka as Yakuko Etsushimaru

• Yurie Funato as Hameko Easygoing Anal Angel

• Ayaka Shimizu as Kaoruko Nishi

• Shiori Izawa as Aruko Sakai

• Tetsu Inada as the Landlord

• Rina Honnizumi as Imoko

• Yuu Kobayashi as Penpen Neko

• Niina Nakabayashi as Jikaki Neko

Netflix and OceanVeil stream the anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Happy Kanako's Killer Life Season 2 Reveals 3 New Cast Members
content:
The DMM TV streaming service announced new cast members for the second season of the live-action series of Toshiya Wakabayashi 's Happy Kanako's Killer Life ( Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu ) manga on Friday.

The new cast members include Hikaru Takahashi as Nana (left in image above), Aoi Morikawa as Ado (center), and Sayu Suzukawa as Yui (right). All three characters are Kanako's assassin colleagues.

Non and Taisuke Fujigaya reprise their roles as Kanako and Sakurai, respectively.

Tsutomu Hanabusa (live-action Tokyo Revengers ) returns to direct the second season, and is also penning the scripts alongside Ruriko Matsushima and Yūsuke Aose.

The first season of the live-action series debuted on DMM TV in February 2025.

Nishino Kanako sure hates her job, and is only too happy to snag the first new gig that comes her way. She never expected that her interview would be at an agency for contract killers…or that she'd be really, really good at bumping people off! Kanako doesn't have a ton of self-confidence, and adjusting to her new life as an assassin isn't the easiest. Will she ever earn the respect of Sakurai, her prickly but kinda hot new coworker? Find out in this dangerously funny, full-color manga!

Wakabayashi launched the four-panel web manga on Twitter and his pixivFANBOX account, and Seikaisha has since serialized the manga on its Twi4 service. Seikaisha published the manga's ninth compiled book volume on May 27. Seven Seas Entertainment released the eighth volume on July 28.

Wakabayashi's Tsuredure Children manga chronicles a series of short school romance stories in an omnibus format. contentBlocks.text: The DMM TV streaming service announced new cast members for the second season of the live-action series of Toshiya Wakabayashi 's Happy Kanako's Killer Life ( Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu ) manga on Friday.
The new cast members include Hikaru Takahashi as Nana (left in image above), Aoi Morikawa as Ado (center), and Sayu Suzukawa as Yui (right). All three characters are Kanako's assassin colleagues.
Non and Taisuke Fujigaya reprise their roles as Kanako and Sakurai, respectively.
Tsutomu Hanabusa (live-action Tokyo Revengers ) returns to direct the second season, and is also penning the scripts alongside Ruriko Matsushima and Yūsuke Aose.
The first season of the live-action series debuted on DMM TV in February 2025.

Nishino Kanako sure hates her job, and is only too happy to snag the first new gig that comes her way. She never expected that her interview would be at an agency for contract killers…or that she'd be really, really good at bumping people off! Kanako doesn't have a ton of self-confidence, and adjusting to her new life as an assassin isn't the easiest. Will she ever earn the respect of Sakurai, her prickly but kinda hot new coworker? Find out in this dangerously funny, full-color manga!
